        "originalContents": "\n\nexport function Globe({\n  dark = true,\n\n  opacity = 1,\n  brightness = 1,\n  offsetX = 0,\n  offsetY = 0,\n  scale = 1,\n  markers = [],\n}: GlobeProps) {\n  const canvasRef: any = useRef\u003cHTMLCanvasElement\u003e(null)\n  const focusRef = useRef([0, 0])\n  const locationToAngles = (lat, long) =\u003e {\n    return [Math.PI - ((long * Math.PI) / 180 - Math.PI / 2), (lat * Math.PI) / 180]\n  }\n  const baseColor: any = [0, 0.3569, 0.4196]\n  const markerColor: any = [1, 0, 0.7098]\n  const glowColor: any = [0.0118, 0.0824, 0.1373]\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    const phi = 0\n\n    const globe = createGlobe(canvasRef.current, {\n      devicePixelRatio: 1.5,\n      phi: 0,\n      // theta: 0,\n      dark: 1,\n\n      mapSamples: 6300,\n      mapBrightness: 8,\n      baseColor,\n\n      markerColor,\n      glowColor,\n      opacity: 0.5,\n      scale: 0.9,\n      markers,\n      // devicePixelRatio: 2,\n      // phi: 0,\n      theta: 0.3,\n      // dark: 1,\n\n      diffuse: 1,\n      // markers,\n      // mapSamples: 16000,\n      width: 600,\n      height: 600,\n      // mapBrightness: .9,\n      // scale: 1,\n      offset: [0, 400],\n      // baseColor: [1, 1, 1],\n      // markerColor: [251 / 255, 100 / 255, 21 / 255],\n      // glowColor: [1, 1, 1],\n      onRender: (state) =\u003e {\n        // state.phi = phi\n        // phi += 0.005\n      },\n    })\n\n    return () =\u003e {\n      globe.destroy()\n    }\n  }, [dark, baseColor, glowColor, markerColor, opacity, brightness, scale])\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    wait(5000)\n    focusRef.current = locationToAngles(markers[0].location[0], markers[0].location[1])\n  }, [markers])\n\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className='h-full w-full relative'\u003e\n      \u003ccanvas\n        ref={canvasRef}\n        style={{\n          width: '100%',\n          height: '100%',\n          // transform: &#96;translate(${offsetX}px, ${offsetY}px)&#96;\n        }}\n      /\u003e\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  )\n}",

        "contents": "\n\n// Interactive markers for locations\nfunction LocationMarkers({\n  locations = [],\n  onHover,\n}: {\n  locations: Array\u003c{ name: string; lat: number; lon: number }\u003e\n  onHover: (location: { lat: number; lon: number } | null) =\u003e void\n}) {\n  const markersRef = useRef\u003cTHREE.Group\u003e(null)\n\n  // Convert lat/lon to 3D coordinates\n  const markers = useMemo(() =\u003e {\n    if (!locations || locations.length === 0) return []\n\n    return locations.map((location) =\u003e {\n      const { lat, lon } = location\n      const phi = (90 - lat) * (Math.PI / 180)\n      const theta = (lon + 180) * (Math.PI / 180)\n      const x = -(2.1 * Math.sin(phi) * Math.cos(theta))\n      const z = 2.1 * Math.sin(phi) * Math.sin(theta)\n      const y = 2.1 * Math.cos(phi)\n\n      return {\n        ...location,\n        position: [x, y, z],\n      }\n    })\n  }, [locations])\n\n  // Animation\n  useFrame(({ clock }) =\u003e {\n    if (markersRef.current) {\n      markersRef.current.rotation.y = clock.getElapsedTime() * 0.1\n    }\n  })\n\n  return (\n    \u003cgroup ref={markersRef}\u003e\n      {markers.map((marker, i) =\u003e (\n        \u003cmesh\n          key={i}\n          position={marker.position as [number, number, number]}\n          onPointerOver={() =\u003e onHover({ lat: marker.lat, lon: marker.lon })}\n          onPointerOut={() =\u003e onHover(null)}\n        \u003e\n          \u003csphereGeometry args={[0.04, 16, 16]} /\u003e\n          \u003cmeshBasicMaterial color=\"#ffffff\" transparent opacity={0.8} /\u003e\n        \u003c/mesh\u003e\n      ))}\n    \u003c/group\u003e\n  )\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n// Interactive markers for locations\nfunction LocationMarkers({\n  locations = [],\n  onHover,\n}: {\n  locations: Array\u003c{ name: string; lat: number; lon: number }\u003e\n  onHover: (location: { lat: number; lon: number } | null) =\u003e void\n}) {\n  const markersRef = useRef\u003cTHREE.Group\u003e(null)\n\n  // Convert lat/lon to 3D coordinates\n  const markers = useMemo(() =\u003e {\n    if (!locations || locations.length === 0) return []\n\n    return locations.map((location) =\u003e {\n      const { lat, lon } = location\n      const phi = (90 - lat) * (Math.PI / 180)\n      const theta = (lon + 180) * (Math.PI / 180)\n      const x = -(2.1 * Math.sin(phi) * Math.cos(theta))\n      const z = 2.1 * Math.sin(phi) * Math.sin(theta)\n      const y = 2.1 * Math.cos(phi)\n\n      return {\n        ...location,\n        position: [x, y, z],\n      }\n    })\n  }, [locations])\n\n  // Animation\n  useFrame(({ clock }) =\u003e {\n    if (markersRef.current) {\n      markersRef.current.rotation.y = clock.getElapsedTime() * 0.1\n    }\n  })\n\n  return (\n    \u003cgroup ref={markersRef}\u003e\n      {markers.map((marker, i) =\u003e (\n        \u003cmesh\n          key={i}\n          position={marker.position as [number, number, number]}\n          onPointerOver={() =\u003e onHover({ lat: marker.lat, lon: marker.lon })}\n          onPointerOut={() =\u003e onHover(null)}\n        \u003e\n          \u003csphereGeometry args={[0.04, 16, 16]} /\u003e\n          \u003cmeshBasicMaterial color=\"#ffffff\" transparent opacity={0.8} /\u003e\n        \u003c/mesh\u003e\n      ))}\n    \u003c/group\u003e\n  )\n}",

        "contents": "\n\nexport function TimeRangeSelector({timeRange, onChange, className = ''}: TimeRangeSelectorProps) {\n  // Minimum and maximum years for the range\n  const MIN_YEAR = 1940\n  const MAX_YEAR = new Date().getFullYear()\n\n  // Local state to track slider values before committing\n  const [sliderValues, setSliderValues] = useState\u003c[number, number]\u003e([\n    timeRange.startYear,\n    timeRange.endYear,\n  ])\n\n  const pulseControls = useAnimation()\n  const lineControls = useAnimation()\n\n  // Update local state when props change\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    setSliderValues([timeRange.startYear, timeRange.endYear])\n  }, [timeRange])\n\n  // Setup animations\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    pulseControls.start({\n      opacity: [0.6, 1, 0.6],\n      transition: {\n        duration: 3,\n        repeat: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY,\n        ease: 'linear',\n      },\n    })\n\n    lineControls.start({\n      scaleX: [0, 1, 0],\n      opacity: [0.1, 0.5, 0.1],\n      transition: {\n        duration: 4,\n        repeat: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY,\n        ease: 'easeInOut',\n      },\n    })\n  }, [pulseControls, lineControls])\n\n  // Handle slider change\n  const handleSliderChange = (values: number[]) =\u003e {\n    setSliderValues([values[0], values[1]])\n  }\n\n  // Apply the changes\n  const applyChanges = () =\u003e {\n    onChange({\n      startYear: sliderValues[0],\n      endYear: sliderValues[1],\n    })\n  }\n\n  // Preset buttons for common time ranges\n  const presets = [\n    {label: '5Y', range: {startYear: MAX_YEAR - 5, endYear: MAX_YEAR}},\n    {label: '10Y', range: {startYear: MAX_YEAR - 10, endYear: MAX_YEAR}},\n    {label: '20Y', range: {startYear: MAX_YEAR - 20, endYear: MAX_YEAR}},\n    {label: 'ALL', range: {startYear: MIN_YEAR, endYear: MAX_YEAR}},\n  ]",

        "originalContents": "\n\nexport function TimeRangeSelector({timeRange, onChange, className = ''}: TimeRangeSelectorProps) {\n  // Minimum and maximum years for the range\n  const MIN_YEAR = 1940\n  const MAX_YEAR = new Date().getFullYear()\n\n  // Local state to track slider values before committing\n  const [sliderValues, setSliderValues] = useState\u003c[number, number]\u003e([\n    timeRange.startYear,\n    timeRange.endYear,\n  ])\n\n  const pulseControls = useAnimation()\n  const lineControls = useAnimation()\n\n  // Update local state when props change\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    setSliderValues([timeRange.startYear, timeRange.endYear])\n  }, [timeRange])\n\n  // Setup animations\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    pulseControls.start({\n      opacity: [0.6, 1, 0.6],\n      transition: {\n        duration: 3,\n        repeat: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY,\n        ease: 'linear',\n      },\n    })\n\n    lineControls.start({\n      scaleX: [0, 1, 0],\n      opacity: [0.1, 0.5, 0.1],\n      transition: {\n        duration: 4,\n        repeat: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY,\n        ease: 'easeInOut',\n      },\n    })\n  }, [pulseControls, lineControls])\n\n  // Handle slider change\n  const handleSliderChange = (values: number[]) =\u003e {\n    setSliderValues([values[0], values[1]])\n  }\n\n  // Apply the changes\n  const applyChanges = () =\u003e {\n    onChange({\n      startYear: sliderValues[0],\n      endYear: sliderValues[1],\n    })\n  }\n\n  // Preset buttons for common time ranges\n  const presets = [\n    {label: '5Y', range: {startYear: MAX_YEAR - 5, endYear: MAX_YEAR}},\n    {label: '10Y', range: {startYear: MAX_YEAR - 10, endYear: MAX_YEAR}},\n    {label: '20Y', range: {startYear: MAX_YEAR - 20, endYear: MAX_YEAR}},\n    {label: 'ALL', range: {startYear: MIN_YEAR, endYear: MAX_YEAR}},\n  ]",

        "originalContents": "\n\nimport {getSightingsBatched} from '@/services/sightings/actions/sightings-time-chunk'\n\nasync function getSightings() {\n  try {\n    // Get current year and use historical range from famous UFO incidents\n    const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear()\n    const startYear = 1947 // Start from Roswell incident for historical context\n\n    // Create time ranges in decade chunks for better historical distribution\n    const timeRanges = [\n      { startYear: 1947, endYear: 1960 }, // Early UFO era\n      { startYear: 1960, endYear: 1980 }, // Classic UFO period \n      { startYear: 1980, endYear: 2000 }, // Modern UFO wave\n      { startYear: 2000, endYear: currentYear }, // Digital age sightings\n    ]\n\n    // Use the server action to fetch data in batches with conservative limit\n    const {sightings, stats} = await getSightingsBatched(timeRanges, 150)\n\n    // Log statistics for debugging\n    console.log(\n      &#96;Fetched ${sightings.length} sightings across the years 1947-${currentYear}:&#96;,\n      stats?.totalSightings ? &#96;${stats.totalSightings} total in stats&#96; : 'No stats available'\n    )\n\n    return sightings\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error fetching sightings:', error)\n    return []\n  }\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Fetch a paginated batch of events data with time ranges\n * @param timeRanges Array of time ranges to query\n * @param limit Maximum records per time range\n */\nexport async function getEventsBatched(\n\ttimeRanges: { startYear: number; endYear: number }[],\n\tlimit = 50,\n) {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Ensure we don't query future years\n\t\tconst currentYear = new Date().getFullYear()\n\n\t\t// Process batches in parallel\n\t\tconst batchPromises = timeRanges.map( ( range ) =\u003e {\n\t\t\t// Adjust each range's end year to not exceed current year\n\t\t\tconst adjustedEndYear = Math.min( range.endYear, currentYear )\n\t\t\treturn getEventsByTimeChunk( range.startYear, adjustedEndYear, limit )\n\t\t} )\n\n\t\t// Stats for the full range\n\t\tconst startYear = Math.min( ...timeRanges.map( ( r ) =\u003e r.startYear ) )\n\t\tconst endYear = Math.max( ...timeRanges.map( ( r ) =\u003e r.endYear ) )\n\t\tconst maxAllowedYear = Math.min( endYear, currentYear )\n\n\t\tconst statsPromise = getEventsStats( startYear, maxAllowedYear )\n\n\t\t// Wait for all promises to resolve\n\t\tconst [batchResults, stats] = await Promise.all( [\n\t\t\tPromise.all( batchPromises ),\n\t\t\tstatsPromise,\n\t\t] )\n\n\t\t// Merge all batches\n\t\tconst allEvents = batchResults.flat()\n\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tevents: allEvents,\n\t\t\tstats,\n\t\t}\n\t} catch ( error ) {\n\t\tconsole.error( \"Error fetching batched events:\", error )\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tevents: [],\n\t\t\tstats: null,\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "import { type NextRequest } from 'next/server'\nimport { getSightingsByTimeChunk, getSightingsStats } from '@/services/sightings/get-sightings'\n\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    // Get query parameters\n    const url = new URL(request.url)\n    const startYear = parseInt(url.searchParams.get('startYear') || '1940')\n    const endYear = parseInt(url.searchParams.get('endYear') || new Date().getFullYear().toString())\n    const limit = parseInt(url.searchParams.get('limit') || '100')\n    const includeStats = url.searchParams.get('stats') === 'true'\n\n    // Validate API key\n    const apiKey = request.headers.get('x-api-key')\n    if (!process.env.INTERNAL_API_KEY || apiKey !== process.env.INTERNAL_API_KEY) {\n      return Response.json(\n        { error: 'Unauthorized' },\n        { status: 401 }\n      )\n    }\n\n    // For large time ranges, fetch in batches of 10 years\n    if (endYear - startYear \u003e 10 \u0026\u0026 !url.searchParams.has('batch')) {\n      const batchSize = 10\n      const batches = []\n      \n      for (let year = startYear; year \u003c= endYear; year += batchSize) {\n        const batchEndYear = Math.min(year + batchSize - 1, endYear)\n        batches.push({ startYear: year, endYear: batchEndYear })\n      }\n      \n      return Response.json({\n        batches,\n        message: 'Time range exceeds 10 years. Data is split into batches.',\n        timeRange: { startYear, endYear }\n      })\n    }\n\n    // Fetch data based on parameters\n    const [sightings, stats] = await Promise.all([\n      getSightingsByTimeChunk(startYear, endYear, limit),\n      includeStats ? getSightingsStats(startYear, endYear) : null\n    ])\n\n    return Response.json({\n      sightings,\n      stats: includeStats ? stats : undefined,\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      timeRange: {\n        startYear,\n        endYear\n      }\n    })\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error fetching UAP sightings:', error)\n    return Response.json(\n      { error: 'Internal Server Error' },\n      { status: 500 }\n    )\n  }",

        "originalContents": "import { type NextRequest } from 'next/server'\nimport { getSightingsByTimeChunk, getSightingsStats } from '@/services/sightings/get-sightings'\n\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    // Get query parameters\n    const url = new URL(request.url)\n    const startYear = parseInt(url.searchParams.get('startYear') || '1940')\n    const endYear = parseInt(url.searchParams.get('endYear') || new Date().getFullYear().toString())\n    const limit = parseInt(url.searchParams.get('limit') || '100')\n    const includeStats = url.searchParams.get('stats') === 'true'\n\n    // Validate API key\n    const apiKey = request.headers.get('x-api-key')\n    if (!process.env.INTERNAL_API_KEY || apiKey !== process.env.INTERNAL_API_KEY) {\n      return Response.json(\n        { error: 'Unauthorized' },\n        { status: 401 }\n      )\n    }\n\n    // For large time ranges, fetch in batches of 10 years\n    if (endYear - startYear \u003e 10 \u0026\u0026 !url.searchParams.has('batch')) {\n      const batchSize = 10\n      const batches = []\n      \n      for (let year = startYear; year \u003c= endYear; year += batchSize) {\n        const batchEndYear = Math.min(year + batchSize - 1, endYear)\n        batches.push({ startYear: year, endYear: batchEndYear })\n      }\n      \n      return Response.json({\n        batches,\n        message: 'Time range exceeds 10 years. Data is split into batches.',\n        timeRange: { startYear, endYear }\n      })\n    }\n\n    // Fetch data based on parameters\n    const [sightings, stats] = await Promise.all([\n      getSightingsByTimeChunk(startYear, endYear, limit),\n      includeStats ? getSightingsStats(startYear, endYear) : null\n    ])\n\n    return Response.json({\n      sightings,\n      stats: includeStats ? stats : undefined,\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      timeRange: {\n        startYear,\n        endYear\n      }\n    })\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error fetching UAP sightings:', error)\n    return Response.json(\n      { error: 'Internal Server Error' },\n      { status: 500 }\n    )\n  }",

        "originalContents": "\n\nexport default function Globe({\n  initialYear = 1940,\n  endYear = new Date().getFullYear(),\n  maxSightings = 500,\n}: GlobeProps) {\n  const [sightings, setSightings] = useState\u003cValidatedUAPSighting[]\u003e([])\n  const [clusters, setClusters] = useState\u003cClusterData[]\u003e([])\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)\n  const [cameraDistance, setCameraDistance] = useState(5) // Medium zoom level\n\n  // Time range for the visualization\n  const timeRange: [Date, Date] = [\n    new Date(&#96;${initialYear}-01-01T00:00:00Z&#96;),\n    new Date(&#96;${endYear}-12-31T23:59:59Z&#96;),\n  ]\n\n  // Use the time series animation hook\n  const {currentTime, isPlaying, timeData, play, pause, setCurrentTime} =\n    useTimeSeriesWithAggregation(timeRange)\n\n  // Fetch initial data\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    async function fetchData() {\n      setLoading(true)\n\n      try {\n        // Fetch sightings data in batches\n        const timeRanges = [{startYear: initialYear, endYear}]\n        const {sightings: fetchedSightings, stats} = await getSightingsBatched(\n          timeRanges,\n          maxSightings\n        )\n\n        setSightings(fetchedSightings)\n\n        // Generate clusters from the data\n        // This is a placeholder - actual clustering algorithm would be implemented here\n        const generatedClusters = generateClusters(fetchedSightings)\n        setClusters(generatedClusters)\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error fetching globe data:', error)\n      } finally {\n        setLoading(false)\n      }\n    }\n\n    fetchData()\n  }, [initialYear, endYear, maxSightings])\n\n  // Handle camera zoom changes\n  function handleZoomChange(distance: number) {\n    setCameraDistance(distance)\n  }",

        "contents": "export function useSightingsData({\n\tinitialTimeRange,\n\tchunkSize = 5,\n\tinitialFilters = {},\n}: UseSightingsDataParams = {}) {\n\n\n\t...\n\n\n\t// Function to fetch data with current time range and filters\n\tconst fetchData = useCallback(async () =\u003e {\n\t\tsetIsLoading(true);\n\t\tsetError(null);\n\n\t\ttry {\n\t\t\tconst timeChunks = getTimeChunks(timeRange);\n\n\t\t\t// Fetch sightings and events in parallel\n\t\t\tconst [sightingsData, eventsData] = await Promise.all([\n\t\t\t\tgetSightingsBatched(timeChunks, 100),\n\t\t\t\tgetEventsBatched(timeChunks, 100),\n\t\t\t]);\n\n\t\t\t// Apply client-side filters to sightings\n\t\t\tconst filteredSightings = sightingsData.sightings.filter((sighting) =\u003e {\n\t\t\t\t// Shape filter\n\t\t\t\tif (\n\t\t\t\t\tfilters.shape \u0026\u0026\n\t\t\t\t\tsighting.category \u0026\u0026\n\t\t\t\t\t!sighting.category.includes(filters.shape.toLowerCase())\n\t\t\t\t) {\n\t\t\t\t\treturn false;\n\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\t// Location filter (basic implementation)\n\t\t\t\tif (\n\t\t\t\t\tfilters.location \u0026\u0026\n\t\t\t\t\tsighting.location.city \u0026\u0026\n\t\t\t\t\t!sighting.location.city\n\t\t\t\t\t\t.toLowerCase()\n\t\t\t\t\t\t.includes(filters.location.toLowerCase())\n\t\t\t\t) {\n\t\t\t\t\treturn false;\n\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\treturn true;\n\t\t\t});\n\n\t\t\t// Update state with fetched data\n\t\t\tsetSightings(filteredSightings);\n\t\t\tsetEvents(eventsData.events);\n\n\t\t\t// Combine stats\n\t\t\tsetStats({\n\t\t\t\tsightings: sightingsData.stats,\n\t\t\t\tevents: eventsData.stats,\n\t\t\t});\n\t\t} catch (err) {\n\t\t\tconsole.error(\"Error fetching data:\", err);\n\t\t\tsetError(\"Failed to fetch data. Please try again.\");\n\t\t} finally {\n\t\t\tsetIsLoading(false);\n\t\t}\n\t}, [timeRange, filters, getTimeChunks]);\n\n\t// Fetch data on initial render and when dependencies change\n\tuseEffect(() =\u003e {\n\t\tfetchData();\n\t}, [fetchData]);\n\n\t// Function to update time range\n\tconst updateTimeRange = useCallback((newRange: TimeRange) =\u003e {\n\t\tsetTimeRange(newRange);\n\t}, []);\n\n\t// Function to update filters\n\tconst updateFilters = useCallback((newFilters: FilterOptions) =\u003e {\n\t\tsetFilters((prev) =\u003e ({ ...prev, ...newFilters }));\n\t}, []);\n\n\treturn {\n\t\tsightings,\n\t\tevents,\n\t\tstats,\n\t\tisLoading,\n\t\terror,\n\t\ttimeRange,\n\t\tfilters,\n\t\tupdateTimeRange,\n\t\tupdateFilters,\n\t\trefreshData: fetchData,\n\t};\n}",

+"use client"
+
+import { usePathname, useRouter, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation'
+import { useCallback, useMemo } from 'react'
+
+export default function TimeControls({
+  defaultStartYear,
+  defaultEndYear,
+}: {
+  defaultStartYear?: number
+  defaultEndYear?: number
+}) {
+  const router = useRouter()
+  const pathname = usePathname()
+  const params = useSearchParams()
+
+  const startYear = useMemo(
+    () =&gt; Number(params.get('startYear') || defaultStartYear || 1947),
+    [params, defaultStartYear],
+  )
+  const endYear = useMemo(
+    () =&gt; Number(params.get('endYear') || defaultEndYear || new Date().getFullYear()),
+    [params, defaultEndYear],
+  )
+
+  const setYears = useCallback(
+    (s: number, e: number) =&gt; {
+      const sp = new URLSearchParams(params.toString())
+      sp.set('startYear', String(s))
+      sp.set('endYear', String(e))
+      router.replace(&#96;${pathname}?${sp.toString()}&#96;)
+    },
+    [router, pathname, params],
+  )
+
+  return (
+    &lt;div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2"&gt;
+      &lt;div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground"&gt;Timeline:&lt;/div&gt;
+      &lt;button className="rounded bg-secondary px-2 py-1 text-sm" onClick={() =&gt; setYears(1947, 1970)}&gt;
+        1947–1970
+      &lt;/button&gt;
+      &lt;button className="rounded bg-secondary px-2 py-1 text-sm" onClick={() =&gt; setYears(1970, 1990)}&gt;
+        1970–1990
+      &lt;/button&gt;
+      &lt;button className="rounded bg-secondary px-2 py-1 text-sm" onClick={() =&gt; setYears(1990, 2010)}&gt;
+        1990–2010
+      &lt;/button&gt;
+      &lt;button className="rounded bg-secondary px-2 py-1 text-sm" onClick={() =&gt; setYears(2010, new Date().getFullYear())}&gt;
+        2010–Now
+      &lt;/button&gt;
+    &lt;/div&gt;
+  )
+}
+
*** End Patch
